name: Cards
title: cards.langa.me
shortDescription: Cards allows users to create a personalized deck of conversation cards to enjoy with friends and family. By simply swiping, users can select which cards to include in their deck, tailoring the game experience to their preferences. Ideal for social gatherings, this tool enhances interactions and provides a fun, engaging way to converse.
pros: Easy to use with simple swiping mechanism
cons: May not appeal to all age groups
